stores.title: Shopify stores
stores.description: Store domains or URLs, e.g. allbirds.com or https://shop.example.com. Any Shopify storefront with a public catalog works.

collectionHandle.title: Collection handle (optional)
collectionHandle.description: Scrape only one collection instead of the whole catalog, e.g. mens-shoes (the last part of the /collections/... URL). Applied to every store in the list.

flattenVariants.title: One record per variant
flattenVariants.description: Instead of one record per product with a variants array, output one record per variant with the product fields repeated. Handy for spreadsheets and price monitoring.

maxProductsPerStore.title: Max products per store
maxProductsPerStore.description: Stop after this many products per store. 0 means the whole catalog.
